effects: The signer sends `amount` TANSSI (the vault's collateral, 0x553F…24AB) to the vault through transferFrom, which spends the signer's allowance.
`onBehalfOf` receives vault active shares, calculated from the vault's current stake and shares; the signer receives no shares unless onBehalfOf is the signer.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 TANSSI into the vault, for the beneficiary address shown, with the vault address.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many vault shares the beneficiary receives; the vault calculates them from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` `_activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(..., activeSharesOf(onBehalfOf) + mintedShares);` The descriptor has fields only for amount and onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: None. The share count depends on vault state at execution.

effects: The vault burns the signer's active shares worth `amount` TANSSI, rounded up.
`amount` TANSSI moves from active stake into the withdrawal queue for the next epoch.
`claimer` receives withdrawal shares for epoch currentEpoch()+1, which give it the right to claim that TANSSI later. No tokens move now.
Slashing can reduce the queued amount before the claim.
formats.shown: Request a 2.5 TANSSI withdrawal from the vault, with the claim owner address shown.

findings.title: withdraw shows the requested amount, but slashing can cut what the claimer can later claim.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol onSlash: `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1] = nextWithdrawals - nextWithdrawalsSlashed;` and withdrawalsOf uses previewRedeem against withdrawals[epoch]. Descriptor label 'Requested assets'.
findings.fix: Optional: keep the label 'Requested assets'. The final amount depends on slashing, which no descriptor can show.

effects: The vault burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Their TANSSI value, calculated from storage, moves into the withdrawal queue for the next epoch.
`claimer` receives withdrawal shares for epoch currentEpoch()+1, which give it the right to claim that TANSSI later.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for the claim owner address shown, with the vault address.

findings.title: redeem shows the share amount as a raw 18-digit integer, but shares use the collateral's 12 decimals.
findings.evidence: ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset returns 0, so shares use the collateral's decimals. Descriptor: `#.shares` 'Vault shares (raw)', format raw. Case 2 shows '987654321123456789' (987,654.32 shares).
findings.fix: Use {"path":"#.shares","label":"Vault shares","format":"unit","params":{"base":"shares","decimals":12}} and change the interpolatedIntent to 'Queue {shares} for {claimer}'.

findings.title: redeem does not show the TANSSI amount queued; the vault calculates it from storage.

effects: The vault uses up the signer's withdrawal claim for `epoch`.
The vault sends the signer's withdrawal for that epoch, in TANSSI, to `recipient`. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient address shown, with the vault address. The screen does not name the asset or the amount.

findings.title: claim never names TANSSI, so the signer does not see which asset goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Claim TANSSI withdrawal' and the interpolatedIntent to 'Claim TANSSI for epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim does not show the amount sent; withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender) reads it from storage.

effects: The vault uses up the signer's withdrawal claim for each listed epoch.
The vault sends the sum of those withdrawals, in TANSSI, to `recipient` in one transfer. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient address shown, with each epoch listed and the vault address. The screen does not name the asset or the amount.

findings.title: claimBatch never names TANSSI, so the signer does not see which asset goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Claim TANSSI withdrawals' and the interpolatedIntent to 'Claim TANSSI for epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch does not show the total amount sent; the vault sums withdrawals from storage.

redeem(address claimer,uint256 shares).worst: redeem shows the share amount as a raw 18-digit integer, but shares use the collateral's 12 decimals.

claim(address recipient,uint256 epoch).worst: claim never names TANSSI, so the signer does not see which asset goes to the recipient.
